tools.name: bexio_get_company_profile
tools.description: The bexio company's profile: name, address, legal form, VAT (MWST) and UID numbers, contact details. Each bexio account has one profile.

tools.name: bexio_get_current_user
tools.description: The signed-in bexio user (id, name, email, superadmin/accountant flags). Its id is the default user_id of new records.

tools.name: bexio_list_users
tools.description: The company's bexio users (id, name, email). Use an id as user_id or owner of contacts, documents and timesheets.

tools.name: bexio_list_contacts
tools.description: List or search contacts (customers, suppliers, persons, companies). Without filters it pages through all contacts; with filters it uses bexio's contact search (all filters must match). name_1 is the company name or a person's last name, name_2 a person's first name.

tools.name: bexio_get_contact
tools.description: One contact with its address, emails, phones, language, groups and remarks.

tools.name: bexio_list_invoices
tools.description: List or search sales invoices (number, contact, totals, open amount, dates, status). Statuses: draft, pending (issued, open), paid, partial (partially paid), canceled, unpaid (overdue reminder state). Without filters it pages through all invoices; with filters all must match.

tools.name: bexio_get_invoice
tools.description: One invoice with its positions (line items), taxes, totals, received payments and remaining amount.

tools.name: bexio_list_invoice_payments
tools.description: The payments recorded on one invoice (date, amount, bank account, cash discount).

tools.name: bexio_list_quotes
tools.description: List or search quotes (Offerten): number, contact, totals, validity, status (draft, pending, confirmed, declined). With filters all must match.

tools.name: bexio_get_quote
tools.description: One quote with its positions, taxes and totals.

tools.name: bexio_list_orders
tools.description: List or search sales orders (Aufträge): number, contact, totals, recurring flag, status (pending, done, partial, canceled). With filters all must match.

tools.name: bexio_get_order
tools.description: One sales order with its positions, taxes and totals.

tools.name: bexio_list_articles
tools.description: List or search items / products (Artikel): code, name, sale and purchase price, tax, unit, stock levels. Use an id as article_id in a draft invoice.

tools.name: bexio_list_projects
tools.description: List or search projects: number, name, contact, state, type, dates, budget. With filters all must match.

tools.name: bexio_get_project
tools.description: One project with its contact, state, type, dates, invoicing and budget settings.

tools.name: bexio_list_timesheets
tools.description: List or search time tracking entries: date, duration, text, user, contact, project, business activity, billable flag. With filters all must match.

tools.name: bexio_list_business_activities
tools.description: Business activities (Tätigkeiten) for time tracking: id, name, billable default, hourly rate. A timesheet needs one.

tools.name: bexio_list_accounts
tools.description: The chart of accounts: account number, name, type (1 earning, 2 expenditure, 3 active/asset, 4 passive/liability, 5 complete/closing), default tax, active/locked flags.

tools.name: bexio_list_journal
tools.description: Accounting journal bookings: date, debit and credit account ids, description, amount, currency, base-currency amount, and the source document (ref_class, ref_id).

tools.name: bexio_list_taxes
tools.description: VAT (MWST) tax codes: id, code, rate, type (sales_tax, pre_tax, ...), validity. For a draft invoice use an active sales tax (types sales_tax, scope active).

tools.name: bexio_list_bank_accounts
tools.description: The company's bank accounts shown in bexio banking: name, bank, IBAN / QR-IBAN, currency, linked ledger account, QR-invoice mode.

tools.name: bexio_list_currencies
tools.description: Currencies set up in bexio (id, code such as CHF or EUR, rounding), optionally with the exchange rate valid on a date. Use an id as currency_id.

tools.name: bexio_list_business_years
tools.description: Accounting business (fiscal) years: start, end, status (open, locked, closed).

tools.name: bexio_list_bills
tools.description: Supplier bills (Kreditoren / purchase bills): document number, vendor, title, status, gross/net, pending amount, bill and due date, overdue flag. status: DRAFTS, TODO (booked, not fully paid), PAID, OVERDUE.

tools.name: bexio_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a new contact (company or person) in bexio. Nothing existing is changed. For a person, name is the last name and first_name the first name. Owner and responsible user default to the signed-in user.

tools.name: bexio_create_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note (call log, meeting minutes, follow-up) to a contact and/or project in bexio. Nothing existing is changed.

tools.name: bexio_create_timesheet
tools.description: WRITE: log time in bexio: either date + duration (HH:MM), or start + end. Needs a business activity (bexio_list_business_activities). Nothing existing is changed.

tools.name: bexio_create_draft_invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create a DRAFT invoice in bexio for a contact, with custom, item (article) and text lines. It is never issued, sent or booked: the user reviews and issues it in bexio. Taxes must be active sales taxes (bexio_list_taxes with types sales_tax, scope active).

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "bexio_list_articles" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: name, code, order_by, descending, limit, offset

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bexio_get_current_user, bexio_list_users, bexio_get_contact · Private data: bexio_get_company_profile, bexio_get_current_user, bexio_list_users, bexio_list_contacts, bexio_get_contact, bexio_list_invoices, bexio_list_quotes, bexio_list_orders, bexio_list_projects, bexio_get_project, bexio_list_timesheets, bexio_list_journal, bexio_list_bills, bexio_create_contact, bexio_create_note, bexio_create_draft_invoice · Public sink: bexio_get_current_user, bexio_list_users.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bexio_get_current_user, bexio_list_users, bexio_get_contact · Private data: bexio_get_company_profile, bexio_get_current_user, bexio_list_users, bexio_list_contacts, bexio_get_contact, bexio_list_invoices, bexio_list_quotes, bexio_list_orders, bexio_list_projects, bexio_get_project, bexio_list_timesheets, bexio_list_journal, bexio_list_bills, bexio_create_contact, bexio_create_note, bexio_create_draft_invoice · Public sink: bexio_get_current_user, bexio_list_users

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
